# 08_rank_cells.R --------------------------------------------------------------
# The decision-support function. Given the location of a detected HPAI case,
# rank every other grid cell by its risk of belonging to the same
# epidemiological event.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(data.table); library(geosphere); library(ggplot2) })

HPAI_RES <- 0.25
hpai_dir <- function() getOption("hpai.data", file.path("data", "processed"))
MODEL_NAMES <- c(combined = "All HPAI events", poultry = "Poultry events", wild = "Wild-bird events")
.hpai <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

f32 <- function(v) {                                    # xgboost compares in float32
  ok <- !is.na(v); out <- as.numeric(v)
  if (any(ok)) out[ok] <- readBin(writeBin(out[ok], raw(), size = 4), "double", size = 4, n = sum(ok))
  out
}

hpai_predict <- function(X, model) {
  X <- matrix(f32(as.vector(X)), nrow(X), ncol(X))
  n <- nrow(X); margin <- rep(model$base_margin, n)
  for (tr in model$trees) {
    node <- rep.int(0L, n)
    repeat {
      act <- tr$left[node + 1L] != -1L
      if (!any(act)) break
      ia <- which(act); nd <- node[ia] + 1L
      x  <- X[cbind(ia, tr$feat[nd])]
      goL <- ifelse(is.na(x), tr$dleft[nd], x < tr$cond[nd])
      node[ia] <- ifelse(goL, tr$left[nd], tr$right[nd])
    }
    margin <- margin + tr$cond[node + 1L]
  }
  1 / (1 + exp(-margin))
}

hpai_files <- c("grid_covariates.csv", "travel_time_min.csv", "corridors.rds",
                sprintf("model_trees_%s.rds", names(MODEL_NAMES)))

hpai_assets <- function(force = FALSE) {
  if (!force && isTRUE(.hpai$ready)) return(.hpai)
  .hpai$ready <- FALSE
  need <- function(p) { f <- file.path(hpai_dir(), p)
    if (!file.exists(f)) stop("missing required file: ", f, call. = FALSE); f }
  .hpai$grid <- fread(need("grid_covariates.csv"))
  TT <- fread(need("travel_time_min.csv"))
  m <- as.matrix(TT[, -1]); rownames(m) <- TT[[1]]
  .hpai$ttm  <- m
  .hpai$cidx <- setNames(seq_along(colnames(m)), colnames(m))
  .hpai$corr <- readRDS(need("corridors.rds"))
  .hpai$kidx <- setNames(seq_len(nrow(.hpai$corr$wb)), rownames(.hpai$corr$wb))   # corridor lookup by name
  .hpai$models <- lapply(setNames(names(MODEL_NAMES), names(MODEL_NAMES)),
                         function(mn) readRDS(need(sprintf("model_trees_%s.rds", mn))))
  .hpai$ready <- TRUE
  .hpai
}

rank_cells <- function(lon, lat, model = "combined", top_n = NULL) {
  A <- hpai_assets()
  if (!model %in% names(A$models)) stop("model must be one of: ", paste(names(A$models), collapse = ", "))
  grid <- A$grid; mod <- A$models[[model]]; ttm <- A$ttm; cix <- A$cidx; CORR <- A$corr
  sc <- paste(floor(lon / HPAI_RES), floor(lat / HPAI_RES))
  if (!sc %in% grid$cell) {
    sc <- grid$cell[which.min(distHaversine(cbind(lon, lat), cbind(grid$lon, grid$lat)))]
    warning("selected point is outside the grid; moved to the nearest cell, ", sc)
  }
  S <- grid[cell == sc]; cand <- grid[cell != sc]
  d  <- distHaversine(cbind(S$lon, S$lat), cbind(cand$lon, cand$lat)) / 1000
  si <- cix[[sc]]; ci <- cix[cand$cell]
  ks <- A$kidx[[sc]]; kc <- A$kidx[cand$cell]
  nd <- data.table(
    same_land = as.integer(cand$GID_1 == S$GID_1), log_dist = log1p(d), log_tt = log1p(ttm[si, ci]),
    log_chick = log1p(cand$chickens), wbtot = cand$wb_total, anat = cand$Anatidae, larid = cand$Laridae,
    friction = cand$friction, iba_in = cand$iba_in, iba_25 = cand$iba_25km, iba_50 = cand$iba_50km,
    cor_wb = CORR$wb[cbind(ks, kc)], cor_chick = CORR$chick[cbind(ks, kc)],
    cor_iba = CORR$iba[cbind(ks, kc)], cor_fric = CORR$fric[cbind(ks, kc)])
  Xd <- as.matrix(nd[, mod$FE, with = FALSE])
  out <- cand[, .(cell, lon, lat, state = GID_1, dist_km = round(d, 1),
                  travel_h = round(ttm[si, ci] / 60, 1),
                  chickens = round(chickens), waterbird_spp = wb_total, iba_25km)]
  out[, risk := hpai_predict(Xd, mod)]
  setorder(out, -risk); out[, rank := .I]
  attr(out, "source_cell") <- sc; attr(out, "model") <- model
  if (is.null(top_n)) out[] else head(out[], top_n)
}

map_ranked_cells <- function(L, truth = NULL) {
  grid <- hpai_assets()$grid; sc <- attr(L, "source_cell")
  mp <- merge(grid[, .(cell, lon, lat)], L[, .(cell, risk)], by = "cell", all.x = TRUE)
  g <- ggplot(mp, aes(lon, lat)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = risk), width = HPAI_RES, height = HPAI_RES) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, na.value = "grey88", name = "Risk") +
    geom_point(data = grid[cell == sc], shape = 4, size = 2.6, stroke = 1.1, colour = "#B2182B") +
    coord_quickmap() + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 9)
  if (!is.null(truth))
    g <- g + geom_tile(data = mp[cell %in% truth], fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25,
                       width = HPAI_RES, height = HPAI_RES)
  g
}
